name: world_bank_indicators-mcp
description: World Bank Indicators API (market data): get_series. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: series_id is '<country>/<indicator>': an ISO3 or ISO2 country (or region/aggregate code such as WLD, EUU) and an indicator code, e.g. 'USA/NY.GDP.MKTP.CD' (GDP, current US$), 'BRA/FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG' (inflation). Annual points, newest first, value null where missing. A date window is sent only when both start and end are given (the years are used).
